lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice discussing a simple current event or local update with det verkar som att.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two colleagues react to a brief news item, local event, or workplace-adjacent update.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Summarizing and reacting to accessible native-style information.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a simple current event such as weather changes, a local event, transport news, or a new café opening.

main_focus.name: impression with det verkar som att
main_focus.description: Use det verkar som att to describe an impression based on something heard or read.
model_examples: Det verkar som att det blir mycket folk i centrum.
Det verkar som att bussen går oftare nu.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use det verkar som att naturally 2-3 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use accessible news vocabulary tied to practical effects and opinions.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person mentions a simple current update.
dialogue_shape.middle: They summarize the update, give an impression, and react with an opinion.
dialogue_shape.ending: They state whether the update matters to their day or plans.

target_complexity.repetition: use impression language without turning the dialogue into a report

focus: the impression formed from the update
whether the update affects the plan or daily life

sentence_focus: one sentence with det verkar som att
one sentence with jag hörde att
one sentence with jag läste att
one sentence asking for an opinion
one sentence about how an update affects everyday life
